title: Word Frequency
description:
Read one line of text. Print each different word (lower-cased) with its count, one per line as `word count`, sorted alphabetically.

For `to be or not to be` print:
```
be 2
not 1
or 1
to 2
```
starter_code:
text = input()
# Count the words and print them alphabetically

visible_tests.stdin: to be or not to be
